kjv: let her (the young virgin) cherish him (the king)
mine: let her (the young virgin) be his (the king's) nurse
note: sokhenet means attendant or nurse. In modern English "cherish" means to love or treasure. Same word in v. 4.

kjv: his (Adonijah's) father had not displeased him at any time
mine: His (Adonijah's) father had never once rebuked him
note: 'atsavo means "pained, crossed" him, so David never reproved him. "Displeased" now sounds like the reverse.
yechi hammelekh means "may the king live". The KJV uses the English royal acclamation, which adds "God". Same in vv. 34, 39.
